findings.title: Materials' 54-point lens gap is a bet on a turnaround
findings.body: Materials sits at the 92nd percentile on trailing earnings but the 38th on forward estimates, a 54-point spread. The market is underwriting 123 percent earnings growth, which would be a historic reversal for a sector whose trailing multiple is near its five-year ceiling.

findings.title: Health Care's one-month slide erased its forward premium
findings.body: Health Care's forward percentile dropped 22 points in a month, from near the top of its range to the 75th percentile, while its trailing percentile barely moved. The 46 percent multiple compression implies analysts expect 86 percent earnings growth, a level of optimism that now looks priced at a discount to the sector's own history.

findings.title: Communication Services is the cheapest forward but not cheap on trailing
findings.body: Communication Services trades at the 2nd percentile on forward earnings, yet its trailing multiple is at the 29th percentile, a 26-point gap. The market is pricing in 57 percent earnings growth, but the trailing lens says the sector has not delivered anything close to that recently, so the cheapness is entirely an expectation, not a record.
